newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in UK up on firm dollar, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in UK up on firm dollar, trade thin.

text.p: The stronger U.S. dollar, which was trading around a 50-month peak against the Japanese yen on Monday, helped push Japanese shares higher late afternoon.
Trading volume remained light, however as investors continued to fret about Wall Street's recent volatility.
"The strong dollar is helping the market, especially exporters," one dealer said. We haven't had a lot of trades but there is some confidence out there."
The dollar was trading at around 125.80 yen by 1525 GMT, its best level in over four years.
Sony Corp 6758Q.T was trading at 9,000 yen after closing in Tokyo at 8,980 yen while Hitachi rose to 1,115 yen from Tokyo's 1,110 yen.
